matches.preview: The forecasting model gives Wolverhampton Wanderers a strong 60% chance of securing a home victory, while a draw stands at 24% and a Blackburn Rovers win is rated at 17%. The home side ended last season without a victory in six matches, drawing three and losing three. Blackburn Rovers also struggled late last term, managing just one win from their final six league fixtures. Past head-to-head meetings between the teams are now distant history, dating back to 2017 and earlier. On total goals, the model is split evenly, offering an exact 50% likelihood for both over and under 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型顯示 Wolverhampton Wanderers 有 60% 的高機率取得主場勝利，和局機率為 24%，而 Blackburn Rovers 獲勝的機率則是 17%。主隊在上賽季末以連續六場不勝收尾，戰績為三和三負。Blackburn Rovers 在上賽季尾聲同樣表現掙扎，最後六場聯賽中僅獲得一勝。兩隊過去的對戰紀錄已年代久遠，可追溯至 2017 年或更早。在總進球數方面，模型呈現均等對分，總進球數高於與低於 2.5 球的機率皆正好為 50%。

matches.preview: The model gives Bolton Wanderers a slight edge at 40% for this Championship fixture, with a Preston North End win calculated at 32% and the draw at 29%. Bolton are returning to this level, having closed their previous second-tier history with six consecutive defeats in 2019. Preston ended last season with mixed results, though both of their final wins came away from home. Historical meetings also favour the visitors, who are unbeaten in their last five matches against Bolton. The statistical projection favours a lower-scoring match, rating under 2.5 goals at a 54% probability.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型顯示 Bolton Wanderers 在這場 Championship 賽事中略佔優勢，獲勝機率為 40%，Preston North End 獲勝機率經計算為 32%，和局則為 29%。Bolton 正重返此一級別，他們在 2019 年以六連敗結束了先前的第二級聯賽歷程。Preston 上季結尾的表現喜憂參半，不過他們最後獲得的兩場勝仗皆來自客場。歷史交手紀錄同樣有利於客隊，他們在最近五次對戰 Bolton 的比賽中保持不敗。統計預測傾向於低比分的賽事，評估總進球數低於 2.5 球的機率為 54%。

matches.preview: The model indicates this contest is finely balanced, giving Bristol City a narrow 37% chance of victory compared to 35% for Millwall, with the draw at 28%. Millwall closed last season strongly by going undefeated in their final five matches. The visitors also hold the upper hand in recent head-to-head encounters, having won both meetings between the clubs in December 2025. Bristol City finished their previous campaign in mixed form, winning twice in their last six games. The statistical forecast leans towards a lower-scoring match, rating the likelihood of under 2.5 total goals at 53%.
matches.preview_zh: 數據模型顯示這場對決勢均力敵，評估 Bristol City 獲勝機率為 37%，略高於 Millwall 的 35%，和局機率則為 28%。Millwall 在上賽季尾聲展現強勁勢頭，最後五場比賽保持不敗。客隊在近期的對戰交手中也佔據上風，於 2025 年 12 月的兩次對決中皆取得勝利。Bristol City 在上個賽季結束時狀態起伏，近六場比賽僅贏得兩場。統計預測傾向這是一場進球數較少的比賽，總進球數少於 2.5 球的機率估計為 53%。

matches.preview: The model views this Championship fixture as finely balanced, giving Derby County a 36% chance of victory against Charlton Athletic at 35%, alongside a 29% probability for the draw. Recent head-to-head encounters lean slightly towards the visitors, who won 2-1 at Charlton in January 2026 following a 1-1 draw earlier that season. Charlton managed only one victory from their final six league matches at the close of last term. Derby were more varied, recording three wins and three defeats across their final six fixtures. Regarding total goals, the forecast leans towards a lower-scoring match, placing a 55% probability on under 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為這場英冠聯賽對局勢均力敵，預估 Derby County 的勝率為 36%，Charlton Athletic 為 35%，和局概率則為 29%。近期兩隊對戰紀錄微幅偏向客隊，繼該賽季早前打成 1-1 平局後，客隊於 2026 年 1 月在 Charlton 主場以 2-1 取勝。Charlton 在上賽季尾聲的最後六場聯賽中僅取得一勝。Derby 的表現則較多變，最後六場比賽取得三勝三負。在總進球數方面，預測偏向進球較少的賽事，總進球數少於 2.5 球的概率為 55%。

matches.preview: The forecast model strongly favours Middlesbrough, giving the hosts a 70% probability of victory. Lincoln City enter the fixture with no recent match history on record and no prior head-to-head meetings between the two sides. Middlesbrough concluded their previous campaign with positive home results, including a 5-1 win against Watford and a 1-0 victory over Sheffield Wednesday towards the end of April. With an away win assessed at just 11% and the draw at 19%, the metrics point heavily towards the home team. The statistical projections also indicate a higher-scoring match, favouring over 2.5 total goals at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型高度看好 Middlesbrough，給予主隊 70% 的勝率。Lincoln City 在無近期比賽紀錄的情況下參賽，且兩隊過去並無交手紀錄。Middlesbrough 在上季末展現良好的主場成績，包括四月底以 5-1 大勝 Watford 以及以 1-0 擊敗 Sheffield Wednesday。在客勝機率評估僅有 11%、和局機率為 19% 的情況下，各項數據皆強烈指向主隊。統計預測同時顯示本場比賽可能出現較多進球，總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率達到 57%。

matches.preview: The forecasting model moderately favours Norwich City, giving the home team a 46% probability of securing victory compared to 26% for West Bromwich Albion and 27% for the draw. Norwich hold the edge in recent head-to-head meetings, most notably recording a 5-0 away win in January 2026. However, the visiting side demonstrated strong defensive consistency towards the end of last season, keeping four clean sheets across their final six league matches. Despite Norwich's high-scoring win in their previous encounter, the statistical model leans towards a lower-scoring fixture, giving under 2.5 goals a 52% probability.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型適度看好 Norwich City，給予主隊 46% 的獲勝機率，相比之下 West Bromwich Albion 為 26%，和局則為 27%。Norwich 在近期的交手紀錄中占據優勢，最顯著的是在 2026 年 1 月於客場取得 5 比 0 的勝利。然而，客隊在上賽季末段展現出強大的防守穩定度，在最後六場聯賽中保持了四場零封。儘管 Norwich 在上一次交手取得高比分的勝利，但統計模型傾向於低比分的賽事，預估總進球數少於 2.5 球的機率為 52%。

matches.preview: The model gives Portsmouth a moderate advantage at 43% to win, compared to 30% for Queens Park Rangers and 27% for the draw. Portsmouth closed the previous campaign in decent shape on home soil, winning two and drawing one of their final three home fixtures. By contrast, Queens Park Rangers ended last season with four consecutive defeats. Head-to-head history shows Portsmouth winning two of the last four meetings, although Rangers claimed a 6-1 victory in the most recent encounter in March. The total-goals prediction leans marginally towards over 2.5 goals at a 51% probability.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型顯示 Portsmouth 稍佔優勢，勝率為 43%，相較之下 Queens Park Rangers 為 30%，和局機率則為 27%。Portsmouth 在上賽季尾聲的主場表現相當不錯，最後三場主場賽事取得兩勝一和。相較之下，Queens Park Rangers 上賽季則是以四連敗作收。對戰歷史顯示，Portsmouth 在近四次交手中贏得兩場，不過 Rangers 在三月的最近一次對決中以 6 比 1 取得勝利。總進球數預測則稍微偏向大於 2.5 球，機率為 51%。

matches.preview: The model gives Stoke City a slight edge with a 38% probability of a home win, though the fixture remains finely balanced against a 33% chance for Swansea City and 29% for a draw. The hosts ended the previous campaign in poor form, failing to win any of their final six matches and losing five. Conversely, Swansea closed out last season strongly, taking three wins from their final five league games. Head-to-head history is split, as both teams won their respective home fixtures when they met in the 2025-26 season. Finally, the model leans towards a lower-scoring outcome, rating under 2.5 total goals at 56%.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型給予 Stoke City 微弱優勢，主勝機率為 38%，不過這場對決依然勢均力敵，Swansea City 勝率為 33%，和局機率則為 29%。主隊在上賽季末段狀態低迷，最後六場比賽未嘗勝績且吞下五敗。相反地，Swansea City 上賽季收尾表現強勁，在最後五場聯賽中取得三勝。雙方對戰歷史平分秋色，在 2025-26 賽季交手時，兩隊各自在主場拿下勝利。最後，模型傾向較低進球數的結果，總進球數少於 2.5 球的機率為 56%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 gives a slight edge to Sheffield United, rating their chances of a home win at 40%, with a Birmingham City victory at 32% and the draw at 29%. The home side closed out last season with mixed results, losing two of their final three matches on familiar ground. However, they are unbeaten in their last five meetings with Birmingham, including a 3-0 victory in December 2025. The visitors ended their previous campaign in solid form, going five games without defeat. A low-scoring outcome is favoured, with the model assigning a 53% probability to under 2.5 total goals.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 稍微看好 Sheffield United，評估其主場勝率為 40%，Birmingham City 獲勝機率為 32%，和局則為 29%。主隊在上賽季結尾表現起伏，於主場最後三場比賽中輸掉兩場。不過，他們在最近五次面對 Birmingham 的交手中保持不敗，其中包括 2025 年 12 月以 3 比 0 獲勝。客隊在上個賽季尾聲狀態穩定，連續五場比賽保持不敗。模型較看好低比分的結果，評估總進球數少於 2.5 球的機率為 53%。

matches.preview: The Oracle90 model gives Southampton a clear advantage away from home, assigning them a 46% chance of victory compared to 27% for Watford and 27% for the draw. Southampton concluded the previous campaign in strong shape, staying unbeaten across their final six fixtures with four wins. By contrast, Watford suffered five consecutive defeats to close out last season, conceding 16 goals during that run. Recent head-to-head meetings also favour the visitors, who won the most recent clash 1-0 in February 2026. The model expects a relatively open contest, rating the probability of over 2.5 goals at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 模型認為客隊 Southampton 佔據明確優勢，預測其獲勝機率為 46%，相較之下 Watford 獲勝機率為 27%，和局機率同為 27%。Southampton 在上個賽季尾聲狀態強勁，最後六場比賽取得四勝且保持不敗。相較之下，Watford 上賽季以五連敗收尾，在這期間一共失了 16 球。近期的對戰紀錄同樣對客隊有利，他們在 2026 年 2 月最近一次交手中以 1 比 0 取勝。模型預計這將是一場相對開放的比賽，出現 2.5 球以上的機率為 54%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 gives West Ham United a slight edge in this fixture, giving an away victory a 40% probability against 33% for Burnley and 27% for the draw. Recent head-to-head records favour the visitors, who won both meetings between the sides last season, including a 2-0 win on this ground in February. Burnley ended their previous league campaign without a win in six attempts, drawing two and losing four. By contrast, West Ham secured two wins from their final five games of last season. The model foresees goals, placing a 54% likelihood on the total exceeding 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 認為 West Ham United 在本場比賽中略佔優勢，預估客勝機率為 40%，Burnley 獲勝機率為 33%，和局機率則為 27%。近期的對戰紀錄有利於客隊，他們在上賽季兩度交手皆取得勝利，其中包括二月在這座球場以 2-0 取勝。Burnley 在上賽季聯賽結尾連續六場未嘗勝果，取得兩和四負；相比之下，West Ham 在上賽季最後五場比賽中取得兩勝。模型預估本場比賽將出現進球，總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 54%。

matches.preview: Oracle90's forecast model indicates a finely balanced match, giving Cardiff City a slight 38% chance of victory against Wrexham AFC's 35%, with the draw at 27%. The hosts return to this level after time outside the top two divisions, so their past Championship campaign ended winless in six games back in 2025. The visitors provide more recent second-tier experience, having won two of their final six fixtures last season. With no recorded head-to-head meetings between these clubs, the fixture starts without historic precedent. The statistical projection leans towards a higher-scoring contest, placing a 55% likelihood on over 2.5 total goals.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 的預測模型顯示這是一場勢均力敵的較量，Cardiff City 擁有微幅領先的 38% 取勝機率，高於 Wrexham AFC 的 35%，和局機率則為 27%。主隊在離開前兩級聯賽一段時間後重返此層級，他們在 2025 年的上一次英冠賽季以連續六場不勝作結。客隊則具備較近期的第二級聯賽經驗，在上賽季最後六場比賽中贏得兩場。由於兩家球隊之間沒有任何對戰紀錄，這場賽事在缺乏歷史先例的情況下展開。數據統計預測傾向於進球數較多的比賽，總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 55%。
